## Analysis

sol_0040 refutes repair bias at the 20-position one-sided scale: exhaustive conditional optimization plus alternating sides and boundary shifts still cannot escape sol_0036. Combined with sol_0037–0039, local and blockwise optimization of the dense-fringe representation is now saturated. The stronger unexplored direction is composition: earlier affine unions improved the tensor lineage from 1.083299 to 1.084017, but this mechanism has never been applied to the substantially better 66-element dense-fringe set. Multiple translated or reflected copies may create favorable collisions unavailable to fixed-core mask changes.

## Next

Exhaust all two-copy placements first, then run 32-replica parallel tempering over copy count, orientations, and translation moves for 150 seconds, checkpointing exact improvements atomically.
